data.name: Efficient Artisan
data.description: You decrease the cost of creating a psionic item by %1%%.  In addition, you treat the base price as if it were %1%% lower for the purpose of determining the time it takes to create the psionic item.  This ability does not stack with other effects that decrease the cost or time of creating a psionic item.|EfficientArtisanReduction
